def same_chars(s0: str, s1: str) -> bool:
    """
    Check if two words have the same characters.
    """
    # Convert strings to sets to ignore order and duplicate characters
    set0 = set(s0.lower())
    set1 = set(s1.lower())

    # Check if both sets are equal
    return set0 == set1
